request.description:
**NEW**: Create product with images and videos in one request!

**Form Fields:**
- Standard product fields (sku, name, description, price, etc.)
- `images`: Up to 10 image files
- `videos`: Up to 3 video files
- `imageDescriptions`: JSON array with title/description for each image
- `videoTitle`, `videoDescription`: Video metadata

**Auto-Processing:**
✅ Images converted to WebP
✅ 4 sizes generated (thumbnail, small, medium, large)
✅ First image set as primary
✅ Videos uploaded and processed

**Note**: Click on 'images' and 'videos' fields to select files from your computer

request.description:
**Upload & Auto-Optimize Images**

**What Happens:**
✅ Converts to WebP format
✅ Generates 4 sizes:
  - Thumbnail: 150x150px
  - Small: 300x300px
  - Medium: 600x600px
  - Large: 1200x1200px
✅ Compresses for optimal loading
✅ Returns CDN-ready URLs

**Supported Formats:**
- JPG/JPEG
- PNG
- WebP
- GIF

**Max Size:** 10MB

**Upload Product Videos**

**Supported Formats:**
- MP4
- MPEG
- QuickTime (MOV)
- AVI

**Max Size:** 100MB

**Note:** For production, consider video transcoding service for optimization.

request.description:
**NEW**: Create product collections!

**Use Cases:**
- Seasonal sales (Summer Sale, Holiday Deals)
- New arrivals
- Featured products
- Bestsellers
- Trending items

**Display Order Options:**
- `manual`: Custom order (you control)
- `newest`: Newest products first
- `popular`: Most popular first
- `price_asc`: Lowest price first
- `price_desc`: Highest price first

**Visibility:**
- `public`: Everyone can see
- `private`: Admin only
- `hidden`: Hidden from listings
Get collection with all products included
Add one or more products to a collection
Change the order of products in collection (only for manual display order)
